column3: NASB adds “for”; the quotation is in capitals.
NASB supplies “sacrifices” (in lowercase within the capitals).
NASB follows the critical text (plural “sacrifices and offerings”); it supplies “in them” and uses parentheses.
NASB follows the critical text, without “O God.”
NASB puts the Old Testament allusion in capitals.
NASB supplies “He then says,” which completes the sentence from verse 15.
NASB follows the critical text (“washed”); “sprinkled” is rendered “having our hearts sprinkled.”
“Think one another toward stirring up” is rendered “consider how to stimulate one another.”
NASB renders “sin willfully” as “go on sinning willfully.”
NASB puts the allusion “the fury of a fire” in capitals.
“Mercies” is rendered “mercy,” and “on the basis of” “on the testimony of.”
NASB follows the critical text, without “says the Lord.”
